title: Bilateral negotiation
description: Two parties (Buyer + Seller) with private valuations negotiate over price across multiple rounds. Watch concession patterns, deadlocks, and final agreement gap.

classes.name: Buyer
classes.proseIdentity: A buyer with a willingness-to-pay of 80. Patient, risk-averse, prefers to anchor low and concede slowly.
classes.initialGoal: Buy at the lowest price possible.

classes.name: Seller
classes.proseIdentity: A seller with a reservation of 50. Slightly impatient, signals commitment by holding firm in early rounds, then concedes.

readmeMd:
# Bilateral negotiation

With a 30-point ZOPA (50–80) and deadline pressure rising at tick 25, where does the agreement land?
